title: Introducing text and code embeddings
summary: We are introducing embeddings, a new endpoint in the OpenAI API that makes it easy to perform natural language and code tasks like semantic search, clustering, topic modeling, and classification.
body: We are introducing embeddings, a new endpoint in the OpenAI API that makes it easy to perform natural language and code tasks like semantic search, clustering, topic modeling, and classification.
summaryZh: OpenAI在API中引入了全新的文本和代码嵌入（Embeddings）端点，使开发者能够轻松执行语义搜索、聚类、主题建模和文本分类等自然语言与代码处理任务。原始信息显示：We are introducing embeddings, a new endpoint in the OpenAI API that makes it easy to perform natural language and code tasks like semantic search, clustering, topic modeling, and classification.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing text and code embeddings”。其重要性主要体现在：该端点的推出为开发者在自然语言和代码的向量化、检索及分类任务上提供了重要的基础支撑。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

glossary.explanationZh: 将文本或代码转化为数值向量的表示形式，用于衡量语义相似度。
基于语义向量相似度而不是关键词匹配的搜索技术。
